title: Call shape specification and actionable error hints
creator: Maya Chen
description: Define a pragmatic JSON schema format for tool/function call manifests that balances strictness for safety with permissive parsing for compatibility across SDKs and model outputs. Provide a short, actionable error taxonomy and human-friendly messages returned by the runtime when tool parameters fail validation. Goal: reduce customer incidents where inference outputs fail to invoke tools due to minor shape/typing mismatches and make recovery suggestions explicit in error payloads.
acceptance_criteria: Spec document covering canonical schema fields, optional/required semantics, and versioning rules is merged to RFC folder in Confluence
Runtime will return error objects with stable 'code' and 'recovery_hint' fields for all parameter validation failures
SDK adapters (python & node) include sanitizer hooks to coerce common shapes (strings->ints when safe, comma-separated lists -> arrays) behind feature flag
E2E tests cover 10 representative tool manifests and include deliberate malformed inputs to verify error codes and hints
Telemetry: validation failure metrics segmented by recovery_hint appear in Console within rollout window
implementation_notes: Use a compact manifest consisting of: name, version, params (JSON Schema-lite), examples, and compatibility_profile
Define param types: string, number, integer, boolean, array<type>, object with shallow properties. Avoid full JSON Schema complexity (no 'allOf'/'oneOf' except single-level unions)
Introduce schema version field 'call_schema_v' with initial value '1' and explicit migration rules for '2' (planned for optional union expansion)
Validation returns structured error: { code, field_path, expected, actual, recovery_hint } as part of 4xx response; code namespace: CALL_VALIDATION.*
Recovery hints should be short, actionable, and prioritized: example 'coerce_number' vs 'provide_array' vs 'trim_prefix'
SDKs implement optional 'strict_mode' flag; default stays permissive to avoid breaking existing customers

For streaming responses that include function call fragments, runtime should buffer until a complete params object is produced before validation; if impossible, emit partial_validation_warning with suggestion to reissue
qa_plan: Unit tests for validator with 120 positive/negative cases (edge cases from customer incidents included)
Integration tests: model->runtime->sdk roundtrip using mock model outputs that exercise coercion rules
Load test: ensure validator latency < 1ms p95 at baseline traffic; measure under batching scenarios
Manual exploratory: product/pm to run the 'tool-call-compat' harness against 5 popular open-source agent tool manifests
comments: 2026-03-01 Maya Chen: Created ticket after postmortem with infra-team; customer incidents where models returned numeric IDs as strings caused downstream tool invocation failures. Goal is pragmatic guardrails, not full JSON Schema adoption.

2026-03-03 Arjun Patel: Drafted initial schema-lite proposal. Key trade-off: strict schemas prevent bad calls but increase breakage for older SDKs. Proposal includes 'compatibility_profile' to enable graceful relaxations per-customer.
2026-03-05 Sarah Lopez (Product): Reviewed draft; asked that recovery_hint messages be short (<140 chars) and include example change to make it easy for devs to act.

2026-03-07 Design review: UX for error messages in Console should show field_path, code, and a one-click 'apply sanitizer' snippet for SDKs. Link to mockups: https://drive.google.com/mockups/call-errors
2026-03-09 Arjun Patel: Implemented validator prototype and added unit tests. Uploaded PR (see link). Early results: 'coerce_number' rule fixed ~42% of historical failures in synthetic corpus.
2026-03-11 QA: Found edge case where streaming fragments with trailing commas caused parser to treat object as invalid — added streaming buffer safeguard and partial_validation_warning flow.

2026-03-12 Maya Chen: Approved for cycle inclusion. Next: finalize SDK adapter API, add telemetry events, and schedule canary rollout behind feature flag for 2 weeks. Assigned follow-ups: ENG-100001 (SDK adapter), ENG-100002 (telemetry), PM-402 (customer beta)
error_codes: CALL_VALIDATION.TYPE_MISMATCH - parameter present but wrong type
CALL_VALIDATION.COERCION_APPLIED - runtime coerced value to expected type
CALL_VALIDATION.UNSUPPORTED_FIELD - field not declared in schema-lite
examples: Example 1 - Missing required: '{"user_id": 123}' when schema expects 'user_id' and 'action' -> error: CALL_VALIDATION.MISSING_REQUIRED, field_path '/action', recovery_hint 'provide action as string (e.g., "start")'

Example 2 - Type mismatch: 'page': '5' (string) when integer expected -> error: CALL_VALIDATION.TYPE_MISMATCH, actual 'string', expected 'integer', recovery_hint 'coerce to integer or pass numeric value'

Example 3 - Coercion: runtime coalesced 'tags': 'a,b,c' -> ['a','b','c'] and returns CALL_VALIDATION.COERCION_APPLIED with recovery_hint 'runtime coerced comma-separated string to array; consider sending array directly for predictability'
Example 4 - Streaming partial: model emits '{"task":"summarize","params":{' then stalls -> CALL_VALIDATION.PARTIAL_PAYLOAD with recovery_hint 'wait for complete params or reissue call with full JSON'
